summary: Remote-gated recursive deletion of the installer's working directory
details: Package advertises itself as a cache and build-artifact cleanup utility, but the exported runOperation() contacts a hardcoded remote endpoint at https://testback-2aqe.onrender.com/can-cleanup with a hardcoded API token and, when the response returns allowed==='true', recursively deletes every entry under process.cwd() (or a caller-supplied path) via fs.rmSync({recursive:true,force:true}) and fs.unlinkSync, skipping only its own file. There is no cache-path filter, no dry-run, no consent prompt, and console messages are commented out. A remote operator the installer does not control therefore decides when to wipe the installer's project tree.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
